_comment: ley_lines.json - caster travel (Scripts/player_travel.gd, Scripts/ley_line_node.gd; design: ~/NCT/Aldenexia-Lightfall/Class teleportation Spell Notes.txt). Per zone: 'nodes' are the Ley-Line Nodes an Arcanist (Spire), Wildspeaker (seed-sowing at a Ring) or Chaosborn (blood imprint at a Rift-Site) attunes to by right-clicking it; Spectral Bridge, Root-Tunnel and Chaos Rift can then take their group there. 'position' is [x, z]; the height comes from the ground. 'zone_entrance' [x, z] is where the evacuation spells (Spatial Redoubt, Wormhole, Phase Snap) land: outside the town gate, where new characters appear. Hand-edited: move the nodes freely (use /location in game). Positions are FIRST GUESSES near the landmarks - check them in play. Each class has its OWN sites in different zones (portals on ~/NCT/Aldenexia-Lightfall/Aldenexia Map.png), set with a node's 'class': Arcanist Spires (raised by the Lycaeum before the Lightfall), Wildspeaker Ruins (older than any city; the Green remembers), Chaosborn Rifts (wounds the Lightfall tore in the world). Name them 'the <Zone> Spire' / 'Ruins' / 'Rift'. No 'class' = open to all three. The Outskirts has none - the first is the Dustwind Spire, hidden off the beaten path in its own area.
